name: How long does interior restoration usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior restoration usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The repair duration depends on the severity of the damage, dry-out verification, and the square footage involved. A single-room restoration involving minor drywall patches, trim, and painting can take one to two weeks once materials arrive. Multi-room rebuilds involving custom framing, subfloor replacement, tile installation, and mechanical sub-trades typically take three to six weeks. Timelines can also vary depending on insurance adjuster response times for supplemental approvals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor single-room rebuilds take one to two weeks, while extensive multi-room restorations with framing and custom tile typically require three to six weeks.
